ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 description: So you found that poster about the TerraGroup and Paradigm Shipping merger. I know the deal. A few years back, TerraGroup acquired a controlling stake in Paradigm Shipping. In practice, the company became just another TerraGroup subsidiary. A fleet under their control, ready to move whatever cargo they want. That doesn't give them any special rights when it comes to transporting hazardous materials, but you and I both know how TerraGroup treats official restrictions. And they didn't buy carriers that big just to cut transport costs. I've been meaning to look into this for a while. I specifically searched for information, but even serious journalists haven't produced a single investigation on the subject. Although now it feels like we might have a chance to figure it out ourselves. The day before yesterday I intercepted a distress signal coming from the water, clearly not military. It looks like a large vessel got stuck inside the blockade perimeter and hasn't shown any signs of life this whole time. And now they've suddenly established contact with someone in Tarkov. What were they talking about? I don't know. My setup wasn't meant for intercepting maritime comms, and the signal is weak. You could help with that, however. Nothing complicated. There's a communications tower in the northwestern part of the nature reserve that can give us a cleaner signal. That's what needs to be repaired. Northern part of the Priozersk nature reserve. Look for a red-and-white cellular tower, not far from the Scav bunker. Take a toolset with you.
ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 startedMessageT: The tower relay is dead. A toolset and steady hands, that's all it takes to get us listening.
ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 successMessageT: You did everything correctly. I already managed to intercept another transmission. Nothing great, if I'm honest. The crew was talking to Knight, the Rogues commander. Most likely they want to take whatever is useful from the ship. Or they know something we don't. Either way, we need to move fast. Let's do it this way: I'll dig for information online, you work on the ground.
ff56532d9100ce03006493e9 failMessageText: The relay is still dead. Without it we're deaf.
80627eaca06d7a50d838c784: Locate and repair the equipment under the cellular tower on Woods
07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 description: While I dig for information online, you work the ground. But you won't be able to get into the port terminal. Thinking about the unloading zones, or that terminal with their logo on the customs territory? Unlikely anything is still there. Try the railway station near the lighthouse instead. Most of their cargo passed through there, beyond the water treatment plant. There's no point searching the containers themselves, but the nearby hangar might still have documents. Shipping manifests, freight directives, anything with the icebreaker's name on it. Bring me what you find.
07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 startedMessageT: The railway station, beyond the water treatment plant. The hangar is what you want. Leave the containers alone.
07c1ecde2c4652876fc769b1 successMessageT: Let me guess. "Boreas"? Yeah, I found something too. The thing is, "Boreas" never reached the port. It was blocked outside Tarkov when the TerraGroup scandal started, and the ship and crew have stayed trapped in the blockade this whole time. It could've stayed there much longer. It's an icebreaker, and not an ordinary one. I reviewed its procurement history and known routes. "Boreas" spent most of its time either on autonomous Arctic expeditions or traveling between northern ports. Icebreakers are usually used to open routes along the Northern Sea Route, and TerraGroup has offices in all those ports. But there's zero information about those expeditions or their purpose. Nothing at all.
7af670b7b771dad781eafb0a: Locate and obtain the Paradigm Shipping documentation
5babe420cdde71285254a662: Hand over the Paradigm Shipping directive to Mechanic
9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 description: Now we know what the ship is, so the only question left is how you get aboard and, more importantly, how you get back off. I can find the exact position of "Boreas", but I can't move you across the water and I can't pull you off a deck in the middle of the gulf. That part is on you. Think about who still has access to working vehicles around here.
9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 startedMessageT: Two problems to solve. Getting out there, and getting back. Do not go anywhere near that ship until you have both.
9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 successMessageT: Excellent. I've identified the icebreaker's coordinates, but I haven't intercepted any more transmissions. Most likely the Rogues are already on their way to "Boreas". And remember, this icebreaker could be an important TerraGroup asset. That means it's likely well defended. Good luck.
9d5e3f7d6320a7fd139a2772 failMessageText: Without transport arranged, that ship may as well be on the moon.
82c33ef9da1054dac7e059bd: Arrange transport to reach the icebreaker
